entries.subject: Shape
entries.finding: A sphere of the model radius (Morzinski et al. 2015); no image resolves the planet.

entries.subject: Orbit and mass
entries.finding: Lacour et al. (2021), A&A 654, L2, GRAVITY astrometry and HARPS radial velocities in the orbitize! conventions of Blunt et al. (2020).

entries.subject: Rotation
entries.finding: Zhou et al. (2026), arXiv:2607.13133 (period from JWST/NIRCam photometry, programme 4758) and Kraus et al. (2020), ApJ 897, L8 (spin aligned with the orbit).

entries.subject: Radio
entries.finding: Ortiz Ceballos, Berger and Cendes (2026), arXiv:2609.16720, MeerKAT (SARAO).

entries.subject: A false color from three measured bands
entries.finding: Shown in infrared false color from its measured flux in MKO K 2.184 µm, MKO H 1.614 µm, MKO J 1.2417 µm (Males et al. (2014), as compiled in Best, Liu, Magnier & Dupuy (2024), The UltracoolSheet v2.1 (Zenodo); zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret, Hauschildt & Witte (2012), A&A 546, A14 compute from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the H band at 1,742 K and log g 4.15 (u1 0.803, u2 -0.050): a model, not a measurement of this planet. Its temperature is the 1,742 K of its measurements record; log g 4.15 follows from the mass and radius of its astronomy record (packages/astronomy/data/bodies/beta-pictoris-b.json).
